workflow: Complete character drawings; left-leading and right-leading half cycles generated separately. Atlas extraction selects each connected whole-character silhouette and preserves its RGB and alpha, then applies common scale and baseline. No limb rigging.

prompts.leftPhases: Create TRANSPARENT 2x2 sprite sheet, FOUR small variations of the LEFT FOOT LEADING half-cycle, full intact white dragon girl from reference, same head face outfit style pose scale. Side walking SCREEN LEFT, both shoes point LEFT in SIDE PROFILE. Reverse anatomical stride of reference: BRIGHT NEAR LEFT THIGH comes from dress slit and extends FORWARD screenLEFT, SHADED FAR RIGHT THIGH is behind screenRIGHT. Four frames chronological: top-left left heel forward contacts ground (modest stride); top-right left foot planted, near left knee gently bends and torso lowers slightly; bottom-left left foot still ahead, trailing FAR RIGHT shoe lifts with heel raised on screenRIGHT; bottom-right near LEFT foot planted under forward half of body, far RIGHT knee passing under torso, right shoe just behind LEFT shoe in depth, preparing to swing forward for RIGHT foot contact in reference. No front kicks. Keep hips/pelvis in same place within cell, short chibi limbs, feet close to ground, no leaps, no split limbs. Keep profile shoe heel and toe side view, flowing same hair tail and dragon horns wings. Four WHOLE CHARACTER drawings separated by generous empty transparent gutters. No text, no floor shadow, no extraneous cropped pieces.
prompts.rightContact: Draw ONE full-body white dragon chibi girl in a RIGHT-FOOT-FORWARD side walking pose, based on this identity reference. Facing screen LEFT with SIDE-PROFILE SHOES pointing LEFT. Critical pose: the character's LEFT leg, which is nearer the viewer, stretches BACKWARDS toward screenRIGHT. This bright bare thigh should be on the right of the body, pointing downRIGHT, shoe under the tail. The RIGHT leg is farther from viewer and extends FORWARD toward screenLEFT; show it with noticeably shaded lavender skin, shoe far on the LEFT. Thighs CROSS visibly: near bright LEFT thigh on RIGHT overlaps IN FRONT of the shaded RIGHT thigh going LEFT. There must be no bright near thigh stretching down-left. Redraw the dress hem with a visible slit toward the RIGHT to expose the backward near leg. Far forward leg emerges beneath the LEFT hem, visibly shaded. Use a clear X-crossing two-leg stride, not the open V of input. Ankles and feet side profile, toes LEFT and heels RIGHT, modest stride and bent knees, short original chibi proportions. Whole intact character, detailed original hair/horns/wings/tail/dress, exact face/identity. Not a front kick, not a running leap. Transparent background and 12% padding. No rig, no text.
prompts.rightPhases: Create a TRANSPARENT 2x2 sheet of FOUR full-body walking animation frames of exactly the white dragon girl in reference. EVERY CELL must be the RIGHT LEG LEADING half of a side-facing walking cycle toward SCREEN LEFT. Preserve the reference leg ownership exactly: NEAR LEFT LEG bright bare thigh emerges from RIGHT skirt slit and extends BACK toward screen RIGHT. FAR RIGHT LEG lavender shaded emerges from LEFT hem and extends FORWARD screen LEFT. Do NOT swap these legs; do NOT show a bright near thigh extended left. The leading leg should remain the shaded FAR RIGHT leg in all four cells. Whole intact character drawings, no cut-out leg pieces. Top left: right heel contact, rear left toes almost lift. Top right: right foot bears weight, knees softly flex, body lowers slightly. Bottom left: right foot remains ahead and flat, trailing LEFT heel rises and LEFT knee bends BACKWARD screenRIGHT. Bottom right: RIGHT leg still ahead, trailing LEFT knee comes closer under hip on RIGHT, preparation for next step. All shoes have clear SIDE PROFILE with toes LEFT, no feet pointed at viewer. Keep same camera, face, proportions, hair, horns, gown, wings/tail as single reference. Frame variation SMALL, same scale, exactly four complete figures, ample transparent gutters, no labels, shadows, text or duplicated stray hair. Emphasize far RIGHT foot stays forward at screenLEFT and bright near LEFT leg behind at screenRIGHT, as the supplied image.
